sources.title: 3MF Core Specification
sources.released_version_commit: Published version 1.4.0; release tag 1.4.0, commit 997b385 (2025-02-06).
sources.access_utc: 2026-10-10T04:17:08Z (web-open request initiated in this clock second; response returned by the 04:17:08Z sample).
sources.observed_operation: Read-only open of tagged specification and line-targeted find operations for units, metadata, thumbnails, PrintTicket, components, material names, and filename conventions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Model unit defaults to millimeter, with micron/mm/cm/in/ft/m valid. Package/object JPEG or PNG thumbnails and core properties are optional. Title and Description are well-known metadata. PrintTicket semantics follow the consumer environment; absent or unsupported tickets leave consumers to apply their own defaults. Base-material names express design intent; displaycolor is rendering only. Components carry object references and transforms. Extension use is a-la-carte; unsupported required extensions block processing. Version 1.4.0 recommends double extensions that distinguish model, project, build, toolpath, and other file roles.
sources.applicability: Primary governing source for 3MF geometry, unit, assembly/component, material-intent, metadata, thumbnail, printer-settings, extension, and naming claims in this pilot proposal.
sources.evidence_summary: A standardized 3MF archive can carry unit-qualified triangular geometry, component/object relationships, optional metadata and preview, and consumer-governed print settings. Its file-role naming recommendation gives the pilot a way to label design data separately from machine-prepared projects.
sources.evidentiary_limit: Specifies format behavior, not whether any particular CAD or slicer correctly implements it.
